reviews.title: Better then i expected
reviews.comment:
I must say , i am pleasantly surprised with this case . I just bought it because i had to rebuild my spare pc to have as a back up but end up using it as main pc because after i did it i liked it so much that i swapped the parts and now it`s mine pc #1 lol .
Pros:
Lots of room , pretty , love the front mash it gives you good airflow , cable management is really awesome and easy to do . Also , bottom shroud front panel easy removal so you can connect the cables to psu without hassle . It was the best cable management i ever did because it was easy to rout the cables .  I love that i can install 3x140mm fans on top front back AND bottom , which gives more air like i already mentioned it previously . Lots of usb ports which gives me possibility to connect my mouse and headphones at front for better signal . You can change front and top mash for solid panels if you want more quiet which i dont care about but its there if you need . Latch button for taking the side panel's off is great addition too .
Cons:
Very tight on the bottom between motherboard and shroud so you have to connect the motherboard and front panel connector and other wires before you install the motherboard because it is tough to do it after .
Vertical gpu opening on the back is useless if you have big air cooler which in my case is BeQuiet Dark Rock Pro 4 . There is no room for gpu to stand vertical because the air cooler is too big . Not sure if installing other vertical bracket will work either because motherboard sits too low , so you are stuck with horizontal gpu position only . That is actually big deal because all the hot air from gpu goes into the cpu cooler and temps are higher on cpu because of it . Fan hub could be made for pwm 4 pin fans instead of 3 pin but you can add one i guess for a few dollars .
All in all its a awesome case with those few things to improve but for $180 its not bad .
reviews.author: Hector

reviews.title: Favorite case so far
reviews.comment:
One of the best ATX cases I’ve ever built in.
Super solid case with zero flex in the structure. Very roomy which makes it a breeze to build in. Tons of customization options such as an inverted layout, removable power supply shroud, cable management channels, pull out radiator mounts, swappable front panel, and swappable top panels. The tempered glass is slightly tinted which makes the case look cohesive with all the black. The side panels are easily removed with the press of a button and come completely off, rather than other cases which open as a swinging door. Also makes closing the panels easy even if your cables poke out slightly. Dust filter for the front panel and under chassis. Optional dust filter for the top panel, but I use the noise reducing panels instead. I also use the top as an exhaust, so there’s no need for the dust filter anyway. Tons of channels for cable management and grommets to cover any holes not used. Space for an optional reservoir/pump if you decide to run a custom loop. Plenty of room in the front to run a push/pull configuration and still have a reservoir behind it all. Amazing sleek design. After getting a bequiet case, I’m not sure I can get anything else.
reviews.author: Steven Dang

reviews.title: Great
reviews.comment: I guess this case is a bit old now?  Anyway, I purchased it and really like it.  It's a 5 star case in all ways.  I didn't do my homework and that's on me.  This is a big case.  I thought I accidentally purchased a full tower.  It doesn't fit in my little desk computer area.  That area now houses my modem and router.  That noted, I very much appreciate the space and ease of being able to work in it for a mid-tower, easy cable routing, SSD controller, good instruction manual and online help, and aesthetics.  It's quiet enough that I honestly don't hear my CPU or vid card fans at all.  Doors are very easy to click on and off with the one button push (no screws!!!!).  I only hear my 850w PSU when it kicks on and that's rarely.  It was nice to have the 3 fans included.  I didn't get, but I will eventually get, a water cooler for my CPU.  It's clear that it would be easy to setup a 2 or 3 fan system.  Taking it apart to route wires and do an install was great.  It's a tad heavy but that's ok for me anyway.  Can't go wrong with this case unless you need very light or a smaller case.
reviews.author: msan_msw

reviews.title: Very good overall, but not as quiet as I expected.
reviews.comment:
There may be a contradiction between my 4-star rating and overall assessment of the case.
It went into a high-end gaming PC. It is an awesome modular case, with plenty of space, great cable management. The guts stay cool, as expected. So why 4 stars then? I have a nearly identical setup inside a Thermaltake F30 and it is significantly quieter with the front closed, with pretty much the same temperatures - so it is lacking a bit, and for the price I was expecting more. In fact this beQuiet is quite audible when running, while I wouldn't be able to tell if the Thermaltake is running without paying attention to it - again, when the front is closed and the system is idle. Both systems are using the same CPU, same type of fans and liquid cooling, so it is truly apples to apples, but fans at low speed can still be heard.
